projects.title: BPPIMT Quiz
projects.description: An interactive quiz platform developed for B.P. Poddar Institute of Management and Technology, facilitating engaging quizzes for students.

details.problem: Traditional quiz methods lacked interactivity and real-time feedback, making assessments less engaging for students.
details.solution: BPPIMT Quiz offers a dynamic platform where quizzes can be created, managed, and taken interactively, providing immediate feedback and enhancing the learning experience.

features.title: User Authentication
features.description: Secure login system ensuring authorized access for quiz participants and administrators.

features.title: Dynamic Quiz Management
features.description: Admins can create and manage quizzes with various question types and difficulty levels.

features.title: Real-time Scoring
features.description: Immediate feedback and scoring upon quiz completion to aid learning.

challenges: Implementing a flexible quiz structure to accommodate various question types.
Ensuring real-time performance and scalability for multiple concurrent users.
Maintaining data integrity and security across the platform.

projects.title: Where Is My Bus
projects.category: Full Stack Web Application / Smart Transport
projects.description: Real-time bus tracking and smart public transport platform with live location tracking, route planning, and secure booking system.

details.problem: Public transport users often face uncertainty about bus arrival times, routes, and seat availability. Traditional systems lack real-time tracking and centralized booking capabilities.
details.solution: Where Is My Bus provides real-time GPS-based bus tracking, intelligent route visualization, and secure ticket booking through a unified platform. It enhances commuter confidence and transport system efficiency.

features.title: Real-Time Bus Tracking
features.description: Track buses live on map using GPS and real-time socket communication.

features.title: Interactive Map Navigation
features.description: Google Maps integration for route visualization and location-based tracking.

features.title: Secure Booking System
features.description: Integrated payment gateway for seamless ticket booking.

features.title: Authentication & Security
features.description: JWT-based authentication for secure user sessions.

features.title: Real-Time Notifications
features.description: Socket-based updates for live bus status and movement.

challenges: Handling real-time GPS data streaming efficiently.
Maintaining low latency socket communication.
Ensuring secure payment and booking flow.
Optimizing map rendering performance for multiple buses.
Scaling backend for concurrent users.

projects.title: CollabLearn
projects.description: A full-stack mentorship and collaborative learning platform enabling students to connect with mentors through real-time chat, video sessions, task management, and progress tracking.

details.problem: Students often struggle to find the right mentors, schedule sessions, track learning progress, and maintain structured learning communication in one unified platform.
details.solution: CollabLearn provides an all-in-one mentorship ecosystem where students can discover mentors based on skills and ratings, book sessions, communicate in real time, and track learning progress while mentors manage students, sessions, and earnings efficiently.

features.title: Smart Mentor Discovery
features.description: AI-assisted mentor discovery based on skills, ratings, and expertise.

features.title: Real-Time Communication
features.description: Instant chat using Stream Chat and WebSocket communication.

features.title: Video Mentoring Sessions
features.description: High-quality live video sessions powered by ZegoCloud.

features.title: Task & Progress Management
features.description: Mentors assign tasks and students track learning progress.

features.title: Karma & Engagement System
features.description: Gamified engagement system rewarding active participation.

features.title: Secure Payment & Booking
features.description: Razorpay integration for secure mentoring session payments.

challenges: Maintaining low-latency real-time messaging and notifications.
Handling video session stability and signaling.
Designing scalable mentor-student matching algorithms.
Managing secure payment workflows and session booking.
Synchronizing real-time chat, video, and task updates.

features.title: Professional Profile Builder
features.description: Create detailed profiles including skills, experience, education, and achievements.

features.title: Job Portal System
features.description: Companies can post jobs and users can apply directly through the platform.

features.title: Connection & Networking
features.description: Send connection requests and build a professional network.

features.title: Real-Time Messaging
features.description: Instant chat system powered by WebSocket communication.

features.title: Activity Feed
features.description: Share posts, updates, and professional achievements.

features.title: Media Upload & Storage
features.description: Upload profile pictures, resumes, and documents securely.

projects.title: Live Canvas
projects.description: A real-time collaborative workspace designed for couples, featuring shared drawing canvases, integrated video calls, synchronized watch parties, AI image generation, and romantic interactive widgets.

details.problem: Couples in long-distance relationships or those wanting shared digital experiences often lack a unified platform that combines creative collaboration, communication, and shared activities.
details.solution: Live Canvas provides an intimate digital space where couples can draw together, watch media synchronously, video chat, and interact through special romantic widgets, all in real-time.

features.title: Collaborative Canvas
features.description: Draw together in real-time with synchronized strokes, customizable brushes, and a shared memory vault.

features.title: Watch Parties & Video Calls
features.description: Watch videos together perfectly synced while maintaining video and audio communication via WebRTC.

features.title: Romantic Widgets
features.description: Interactive elements like shared vibe trackers, hidden sticky notes, and countdowns.

features.title: AI Enhancements
features.description: Integrated generative AI for creating images or enhancing the creative process together.

challenges: Synchronizing canvas strokes in real-time without noticeable latency.
Managing WebRTC peer connections for reliable video and audio streams.
Ensuring perfect sync for watch parties across different network conditions.
Integrating AI generation workflows smoothly into the collaborative experience.

projects.title: Off-Road Semantic Segmentation
projects.description: A full pipeline for semantic segmentation in unstructured, off-road environments. Leverages DINOv2 and DeepLabV3+ architectures to achieve robust navigation features for autonomous driving.

details.problem: Autonomous navigation in unstructured off-road environments requires precise semantic understanding of scenes, such as distinguishing between dry grass, rocks, deep puddles, and sky to make safe driving decisions.
details.solution: Built a deep learning pipeline leveraging DINOv2 and DeepLabV3+ with an EfficientNet-B3 backbone. The model was trained using custom augmentations and hybrid loss functions to robustly segment diverse off-road obstacles and terrains.

features.title: DINOv2 & DeepLabV3+
features.description: Advanced backbone and segmentation head integration for high-quality pixel-level predictions.

features.title: Robust Augmentation
features.description: Utilized aggressive augmentations (HorizontalFlip, Rotate90, ColorJitter) to improve model generalization.

features.title: Performance Metrics
features.description: Tracked per-class IoU, Dice Score, and Pixel Accuracy with detailed plot generation.

features.title: Real-time Inference
features.description: Optimized models to run rapid inference on video frames and continuous camera feeds.

challenges: Handling extreme class imbalances between common features like 'Sky' and rare obstacles like 'Logs'.
Optimizing hyper-parameters and choosing the right combination of Hybrid Dice and Focal loss.
Ensuring smooth, jitter-free real-time inference on high-resolution off-road video footage.
